title: EngineeringResult
description: Velith Engineering API v0 wire contract (D33; docs/API_V0_SPEC.md). Owned by Velith. Exactly five fields, constraint-equivalent to Mini Prometheus' consumed stub. Identity: content_hash = 'sha256:' + SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the identity view (this object without result_id and content_hash, plus identity_version 'velith-engineering-result-identity-v1'); result_id = uuid5(924036ea-946e-57d4-9a75-e94278f979aa, content_hash). The hash detects accidental change only: it gives no authenticity, no non-repudiation and no proof that verification occurred.
